text:
maria: Hey team — FinServe reported spikes in API p95 earlier and their trace view shows a bunch of request IDs with no spans attached. sample reqids: `fs-req-8421`, `fs-req-8422`, `fs-req-8423`. They say this started at ~2025-11-03T14:12Z. Can we triage? :eyes:
kevin: Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro and the console screenshot? is this all tenants or just FinServe?
lucy: Only FinServe so far. I grabbed a console snapshot: Time range 14:00-14:30 shows successful requests but trace-view rows are empty for that tenant id `tenant:finserve-prod`. Charts show 0 spans ingested for that window.
maria: screenshot: <link to image> and here's the API error they saw in app logs: `warn: trace-lookup: no-spans-for-reqid fs-req-8421`
aj: Quick checklist: 1) ingestion pipeline healthy? 2) requestid mapping changed (header vs body)? 3) sampling/filter rules?
sre-bot: ingest-pipeline-health: ok for shard-3, backfill queue length: 0, last-forward-check: 2025-11-03T14:05Z
kevin: @aj can you grep the router logs for those reqids? also check if the request IDs were rewritten by the edge (we had a salt change last week).
aj: grepping... got entries in router: `2025-11-03T14:12:18Z router: req fs-req-8421 routed to /v1/generate` and downstream agent ack: `ack id local-ack-6721`. But the trace service log shows `received request id local-ack-6721` not `fs-req-8421` — looks like header rewrite.
maria: customer claims they set `X-Request-ID` header. Are we honoring that or hashing+salting?
kevin: We apply tenant-level hashing to request IDs to avoid collisions across tenants (salt rotates on config push). If edge rewrote header to internal id, mapping should still be preserved by the stitcher which uses `original_request_id` field. Maybe that field missing.
aj: pulled a raw event from the ingestion topic for `fs-req-8421` -> payload: `{ "request_id": "local-ack-6721", "original_request_id": null, "tenant": "finserve-prod", ... }` — aha original_request_id is null. That explains missing spans for the customer's visible reqid.
lucy: So original_request_id null -> UI can't associate spans with `fs-req-8421`. How did original get nulled?
kevin: Two hypotheses: 1) edge proxy had a bug and didn't set original_request_id when it rewrote, 2) recent config change rotated the salt and we applied a transform that overwrote original fields.
opsbot: deploy-notify: config/service/edge-proxy updated by `infra-deploy` at 2025-11-03T13:50Z (change-id: cfg-2025-11-03-77)
aj: That deploy included the new header rewrite patch. I think the proxy started rewriting earlier request IDs to `local-ack-*` but forgot to forward original header into `original_request_id` metadata when the header came from an upstream load balancer.
maria: Customer impact: trace view rows show total request count but zero spans; logs show processing happened but with internal id. They want either the original IDs restored in traces or a backfill to stitch existing spans.
kevin: Short-term: we can add a console mapping that resolves `fs-req-*` to internal ids using router logs for that window. Longer-term: fix proxy to populate original_request_id and run a backfill job to reindex ingestion messages -> set original_request_id where available by scanning router logs and correlating by time + tenant + path.
lucy: Can we repro locally? Steps I used: curl to our edge with header `X-Request-ID: fs-req-test123` -> observed in trace-svc: request_id rewritten to `local-ack-999` and original_request_id null. Curl command:
```
curl -v -H "X-Request-ID: fs-req-test123" https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
kevin: Good repro. Please capture tcpdump of headers between edge and router or enable debug header logging for the edge for 10m.
aj: I enabled header debug on edge for `tenant=finserve-prod` from 2025-11-03T15:00Z to 15:10Z. Also started a consumer reading raw-ingest-topic to capture incoming events.
maria: Customer asked for ETA. What's a reasonable timeline for mitigation?
kevin: Patch for edge will be PR today, qa + canary in infra tomorrow morning; emergency backfill depends on how many messages need touch. Estimate: small window (14:00-14:30) -> backfill job ~2-3 hours to correlate and reindex.
lucy: I'll communicate to customer: "We found header rewrite removed original_request_id for a subset of requests during a recent proxy config change. We are patching the proxy (ETA 24h) and running a limited backfill for the affected window (ETA 3-4h once approved)."
maria: ok send that and ask for any additional sample reqids. Also assign a bug in GH: redwood/ingestion -> issue: `edge-proxy: preserve original_request_id when rewriting X-Request-ID` and link this thread.
kevin: Created issue #1842 and added logs + sample payloads. Tagging @aj for the backfill plan.
aj: Backfill plan: 1) query router logs for mapping `fs-req-* -> local-ack-*` for 14:00-14:30 2) produce a small reindex topic with message patches: set `original_request_id=fs-req-*` 3) run reindex job with dry-run to measure matches 4) apply reindex. Dry-run looks like ~4200 matches for finserve-prod.
opsbot: runbook-check: reindex job requires maintenance-window: false for small tenant; approve?
kevin: Approved. aj please proceed with dry-run first, then we schedule actual apply after customer ack.
lucy: Messaging sent to FinServe support contact with summary + mitigation steps. They replied :thumbsup: and sent two more sample ids: `fs-req-8430`, `fs-req-8431`.
maria: Great. Keep this thread updated with progress and paste reindex job id when started. Thanks all. :heart:
